Justified by 365-day walk-forward and five out-of-sample cross-validation runs.

2026-08-11: Journal decision recording revision v1.1 of the frozen ALGORITHM v1 strategy: after a drop, re-entry is triggered by price returning above the EMA for ETH/stable pools, while cbBTC keeps plain exit. Based on full 365-day runs that reversed an earlier 90-day ranking; base-005 first passed the gate.

2026-08-18: Decision to withdraw the Windows auto-pull runner (agent-runner-git service and .agent-queue) in the HOMOS Uniswap v3 project. Code changes on Windows now require a manual git pull; the only automated git action is the morning report push. Rationale: unused queue and a reset --hard risk after the 17 Aug incident.

2026-08-17: Journal decision recording revision v1.2 of the HOMOS ALGORITHM for pool base-030: the trend breaker becomes a hedge-excess short on ETH above 50% via a perp, with plain exit as fallback until a perp venue is integrated. Rationale cites the only configuration closing the backtest gate on both windows and historical funding.
